step1.title: Direct from Mashiko potters
step1.description: We partner with independent makers in Mashiko, so each piece comes from the kiln that formed it.

step2.title: Photographed and recorded
step2.description: Every work is photographed in natural light and noted for size and weight before it is listed.

step3.title: Packed by hand in Mashiko
step3.description: Pieces leave the studio in custom padding, packed with the same care with which they were made.

step4.title: Shipped worldwide
step4.description: Orders go out with tracking, from the studio to your door, without extra hands in between.
